adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: A Cull Obsidian from 2014 ambushes Tony Stark in the battle at the ruined Avengers Compound, knocking him down and going for him with his arm blade until Peter Parker webs him off his feet.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: An Avenger the 2014 Cull ambushes in the battle at the Compound.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Black Order brute. A 2014 version ambushes Tony until Peter webs him down.
adds.evidence: Battle of Earth: 2014 Cull Obsidian attacks Tony, knocks him over and tries to stab him with his arm blade; Spider-Man webs him off his feet and Giant-Man crushes him.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: A 2014 Ebony Maw pins T'Challa and reaches for the gauntlet holding the Infinity Stones, until Peter Parker swings in and snatches it out of his reach.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Snatches the gauntlet out of a 2014 Maw's reach.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Black Order sorcerer. A 2014 version loses the gauntlet to Peter.
adds.evidence: Battle of Earth: 2014 Maw telekinetically restrains T'Challa and nearly takes the Nano Gauntlet, only for Peter Parker to take it from his reach.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: In 1970 Jarvis picks Howard Stark up at Camp Lehigh. As they drive off, Howard asks him whether they have ever met the man he was just talking to.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Jarvis's employer, picked up at Camp Lehigh in 1970.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Howard's butler, who drives him away from Camp Lehigh in 1970.
adds.evidence: 1970 Camp Lehigh: Jarvis arrives to pick Howard up; Howard asks Jarvis if they had met 'Howard Potts' before, and Jarvis drives away with him.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Back from dust, Drax and Groot rejoin the Guardians after the battle and leave Earth together on the Benatar, where Groot chimes in when Drax says Quill and Thor should fight for the lead.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who leaves Earth with Drax on the Benatar.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who leaves Earth with Groot on the Benatar.
adds.evidence: After Tony's funeral the reunited Guardians, Drax and Groot included, take the Benatar to New Asgard for Thor; Drax suggests Quill and Thor fight for leadership and Groot happily chimes in.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Drax and Mantis step out of a portal from Titan together to join the battle at the Avengers Compound, and afterward leave Earth with the Guardians on the Benatar, where Mantis backs Drax's call for Quill and Thor to fight.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Arrives from Titan with Drax and leaves Earth with him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Arrives from Titan with Mantis and leaves Earth with her.
adds.evidence: Drax and Mantis come through the Titan portal together (filmed together per VFX account); on the Benatar Drax suggests the leadership fight and Mantis agrees they should use knives.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Drax and Quill come through the portal from Titan to join the battle. On the Benatar afterward, Drax tells Quill and Thor to fight one another for the honor of leading the team.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Arrives from Titan with Drax, who says he should fight Thor to lead.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Arrives from Titan with Quill and says he should fight Thor to lead.
adds.evidence: Titan portal returns Drax, Mantis, Quill and Strange; on the Benatar Drax says 'You should fight one another for the honor of leadership' to Quill and Thor.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Rocket and Drax are together again with the Guardians after the battle. On the Benatar, when Drax says Quill and Thor should fight for the lead, Rocket offers blasters or knives.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Back on the Benatar with Drax, offering weapons for the fight he suggests.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Back on the Benatar with Rocket, suggesting a fight for the lead.
adds.evidence: Benatar scene: Drax suggests Quill and Thor fight for leadership; Rocket: 'I got some blasters unless you guys want to use knives?'

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Nebula joins Drax and the Guardians on the Benatar after the battle. When Drax says Quill and Thor should fight for the lead, Nebula agrees it sounds fair.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Drax on the Benatar and backs his call for a fight.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Nebula joins on the Benatar. She backs his call for a fight.
adds.evidence: Benatar scene: Drax: 'You should fight one another for the honor of leadership.' Nebula: 'Sounds fair.' Nebula rejoins the Guardians with Drax, Rocket, Mantis, Groot and Quill.

adds.title: Avengers: Endgame
adds.text: Stephen Strange opens the portal that brings Drax from Titan to the battle at the ruined Avengers Compound.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The sorcerer whose portal brings Drax from Titan to the battle.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian Strange brings from Titan to the battle.
adds.evidence: The Titan portal returns Strange with Drax, Mantis and Quill to the Compound; fandom adds Strange tells them five years have passed, but only the portal arrival is clearly on screen.

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Endgame
owner_calls.question: Tony's snap dusts the 2014 Ebony Maw along with all of Thanos's army. Does killing someone as part of a mass wipe count as dealing with each other for a stage?
options: Add enemy stage: Tony's snap turns a 2014 Maw to dust with the rest of Thanos's army
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom lists Iron Man as Maw's killer for both versions; the only link in Endgame is the snap that wipes out the whole army.

owner_calls.title: Avengers: Endgame
owner_calls.question: When Wanda is overpowering Thanos, he orders Corvus to have the Sanctuary II fire on the field; Corvus protests, then calls the strike that blows Wanda aside. Is that one acting against the other?
options: No stage (they never face each other)
Add enemy stage: a 2014 Corvus calls down the airstrike that blows Wanda away from Thanos
owner_calls.evidence: Battle of Earth: Thanos, crushed in Wanda's energy, orders the strike; Corvus protests over their own troops, the Black Order complies, and Wanda is blown aside.
